verdict.rationale: Temporal exposes most operational primitives (start/query/signal/update workflows, schedules, batch operations, worker management) via CLI/SDK APIs that mirror what the Web UI shows for execution state and debugging (temporal-docs-6, temporal-docs-8, temporal-docs-26, temporal-gh-1). However, there is no explicit documentation stating full UI/API parity, and some UI-only conveniences (e.g., Cloud account/user management, namespace settings) aren't shown to have full API coverage. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or audit, evidence covering admin/Cloud console features via API, and independent/hands-on confirmation that nothing is UI-exclusive.
